issue.title: sase-listen apollo rollout unfinished: Gemini free-tier quota blocks the first real edition and auditions; Funnel feed exposure never proposed
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1e3.12 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #5 and #6); triaged by the sase-1e3 land agent on 2026-10-01.

The rollout phase proved one live Charon clip and rendered and published a full tone-engine episode. Two items from the epic plan's end-to-end verification are still open. Both are blocked outside the epic's code.

1. **No real Gemini edition yet.** The `pass gemini_cli_api_key` key is free tier, which allows 10 synthesis requests per day. The Kore, Iapetus, and Sadaltager auditions and the full Gemini edition of the commute-audio report all hit 429. The chunk cache already holds 8 chunks. Resume with:
   `sase-listen render <research-checkout>/202610/commute_audio_from_markdown/commute_audio_from_markdown_narration.md -n gemini`
   (research checkout: `sase repo path research --ensure`). Then run `sase-listen audition --voices Kore,Iapetus,Sadaltager`, which works once the sase-1e3 landing tale's CLI rebuild is installed. Register the MP3s with `sase artifact create`, so they reach Telegram through sendAudio. Ask the user whether to move the key to the paid tier: the report's monthly-cost table puts a 16-minute edition at about $0.16-0.22.
2. **Funnel exposure was never proposed.** Once the Gemini edition is published, propose
   `tailscale funnel --bg --https=8443 --set-path=/<feed token> /home/bryan/.local/share/sase-listen/feed`
   through `/sase_gate`, or `/sase_sudo` if root is required. Use the token rotated by the sase-1e3 landing tale: the original token was printed into a public bead note and must not be used. Read it with `sase-listen feed --show-url` and never paste it into notes. Per the plan, the gate notes must explain:
   - only the feed directory is exposed, under an unguessable path;
   - port 443 stays tailnet-only;
   - the tailnet policy needs the `funnel` node attribute;
   - how to subscribe in AntennaPod.
